title: Independent Study: Beginning Experiments in Design and Innovation
description:
Permission of Academy for Innovation & Entrepreneurship.

Students will identify and begin framing a self-selected challenge and/or real-world project using design tools and methods, with an emphasis on employing a human-centered, creative problem-solving approach. This course requires a high degree of self-direction in all aspects of the project work, including defining specific milestones and deliverables. There will be regular coaching from an Academy for Innovation and Entrepreneurship team member.
